name: slack-hub
title: Slack Hub
description: Search Slack conversations, people, and messages, find channels by their members, and post or reply using the official Slack Web API.
author: shinonomelon

preferences.name: accessToken
preferences.title: Slack Access Token
preferences.description: Set your User OAuth Token (xoxp-). See README for setup. 自分のUser OAuth Token（xoxp-）を設定してください。取得手順はREADMEを参照してください。

preferences.name: previousHandles
preferences.title: Previous Handles
preferences.description: Previous handles, separated by commas, if you changed your Slack handle. ハンドルを変えたことがある人だけ、以前の名前をカンマ区切りで入力してください。

preferences.name: typesafeApiKey
preferences.title: TypeSafe API Key (Optional)
preferences.description: Optional: sort reply candidates with AI. Confirmation is required before sending text to TypeSafe. 任意設定です。本文をTypeSafeへ送る前に画面で確認します。

preferences.name: language
preferences.title: Language / 言語
preferences.description: Choose the display language, then reopen Slack Hub. 表示言語を選び、Slack Hubを開き直してください。

preferences.name: backgroundRefreshFrequency
preferences.title: Background refresh frequency / 背景更新の頻度
preferences.description: Channels follow this interval; people refresh every 24 hours. チャンネルはこの間隔、メンバーは24時間ごとに更新します。

preferences.name: slackApiDistribution
preferences.title: Slack API distribution
preferences.description: Select verified only after confirming your app is internal or Marketplace approved. 内部利用またはMarketplace承認済みと確認した場合だけ切り替えてください。

commands.name: slack-hub
commands.title: Slack Hub
commands.description: Search Slack channels, people, and group DMs, open them in Slack, and write to them.

commands.name: refresh-directory
commands.title: Refresh Slack Directory
commands.description: Refresh cached Slack directories according to the configured background frequency.
